The main takeaway from our work is that
the plaque burden detected in the coronary arteries of asymptomatic subjects with low/intermediated cardiovascular disease risk is associated with the expected benefit from statin.
a personalized approach to statin therapy is feasible and can be applied to low/intermediate-risk individuals.
